# `tfctl profile profiles list` reference

List existing configuration profiles.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles list [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl profile profiles list` command lists existing configuration profiles. The output shows all available profiles, with the currently active profile indicated.

## Examples

### List existing profiles

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles list
```

## Output

The command displays a list of all profiles, typically showing:
- Profile name
- Active status (indicated for the currently active profile)
- Hostname (if configured)
- Organization (if configured)

Example output:
```
* default (app.terraform.io, org: my-org)
  staging (terraform.staging.example.com)
  production (terraform.prod.example.com, org: prod-org)
```

The asterisk (*) indicates the currently active profile.
